text:
maria: Quick question — customer is scheduling a BYOK HSM rotation across eu-west and us-central. We need to update RBAC, audit log requirements, and KMS-proxy behavior. Any immediate blockers?
ryan: do we have the exact sequence? rewrap in eu, import to us, rotate pointers?
tobi: high level: canary rewrap in eu-west -> attest -> push to proxy -> promote to us-central. keep old key around + dual-signature during cutover.
elaine: important: audit logs must capture operator identity, operation type (wrap/unwrap/attach), HSM attestation blob, nonce, session ID, and the exact firmware version string. retention 7 years for pci/regulatory customers.
maria: agreed. also need our KMS proxy to persist the attestation blob in the key metadata and emit a rewrap event to the activity stream. customer needs chain-of-custody proof.
ryan: we should require HSM-signed attestation on every import. example: `hsm-cli attest --key-id=abc123 --nonce=$NONCE --out=attest.bin` store attest.bin alongside the key record.
elaine: vuln triage question: if the HSM vendor posts a CVE for a crypto engine, do we freeze all rotations or only pause imports until firmware validated? recommendation: pause imports, deny new wrapping operations, escalate to infra sec, run key integrity checks.
maria: RBAC change: we need a temporary 'rewrap-operator' role that is time-limited (max 1h) and requires a 2nd approver before issuance. 4-eyes enforced via approval workflow. thoughts on implementation?
tobi: implement ephemeral role issuance via our auth service + OPA policy gate. example flow:
```
POST /auth/ephemeral-roles {"role":"rewrap-operator","ttl":3600}
// activation requires approval ticket id
```
then IAM token minted with scoped permissions for `kms:importKey`, `hsm:attest`. revoke via `DELETE /auth/ephemeral-roles/:id`.
ryan: logging integrity — write rewrap events to append-only ledger, sign batches with service key, mirror to customer S3 with object lock (governance mode) and to our internal SIEM. ensures tamper-evident trail.
sec-bot: policy-change: RBAC request created by maria; ticket #SEC-4321; status: awaiting-approval :eyes:
maria: for incident playbook, we need a checklist to prove no plaintext exposure:
- confirm attestation signatures verified for all imports
- confirm no unauthorized admin sessions during window
- verify audit stream replica matches primary ledger
- snapshot all HSM logs + firmware state
elaine: add runbook step to run a fast key integrity test (hash of public-wrapped material) and compare to pre-rotation baseline. if mismatch, escalate to full forensic and rotate dependent keys.
ryan: ok happy path understood. blockers: (1) ephemeral role automation (2) attestation storage schema for key metadata (3) append-only ledger pipeline for exports.
maria: action items: @ryan please draft runbook and ledger export spec; @tobi prototype ephemeral-role endpoints; @elaine draft incident checklist and retention policy language for compliance. i'll open PR for the KMS-proxy attestation storage.
tobi: will do — prototyping this afternoon, ping me for pairing.
elaine: ping @maria when you open PR, i'll review compliance wording.
ryan: linking related ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-4321
maria: thanks team. keeping this thread as the source-of-truth for the rollout plan and RBAC decisioning. :thumbsup:
